sloka: ददर्श कान्ताश्च समालभन्त्य ।स्तथा परास्तत्र पुनः स्वपन्त्यः ।सुरूपवक्त्राश्च तथा हसन्त्यः ।क्रुद्धाः पराश्चपि विनिःश्वसन्त्यः ॥५-५-१३॥
transliteration: dadarśa kāntāśca samālabhantya ।stathā parāstatra punaḥ svapantyaḥ ।surūpavaktrāśca tathā hasantyaḥ ।kruddhāḥ parāścapi viniḥśvasantyaḥ ॥5-5-13॥

translations.english: He even saw women collected there, their limbs smeared with unguents on their bodies, like wise women with beautiful countenances laughing at others, some sleeping, and others hissing (sighing) like angry serpents.
